claims.sentence: The improved curriculum had a dramatic impact on an addition problem, making it possible to train an LSTM to add two 9-digit numbers with 99% accuracy.

numbers.sentence: The improved curriculum had a dramatic impact on an addition problem, making it possible to train an LSTM to add two 9-digit numbers with 99% accuracy.
Remarkably, the combined curriculum strategy resulted in 99% accuracy on the addition of 9-digit long numbers, which is a massive improvement over the naive curriculum.
